plan.angle: The top 10 is all quizzes to play: Sporcle, JetPunk, Yardbarker, the BBC, the Guardian, Britannica and HowStuffWorks host their own sports trivia, and Brainpower and SignUpGenius publish question lists to copy. None shows how to run a sports quiz as your own app, with your own questions, scores saved by player, and a list of what people missed. This page gives the searcher both: an 8-question sports quiz to play on the page, every answer sourced, then four sports quizzes a youth soccer club, a middle school gym class, an office fantasy league and a minor league ballpark run as their own app, each saving answers to a table they own.
tab_stories: Wickliffe Youth Soccer sends a 12-question laws quiz to its 26 volunteer referees before the fall season, and the 7 who score under 10 of 12 get an invite to the Saturday clinic.

Dellwood Middle School's seventh-grade PE classes, 84 students in all, take a 10-question volleyball quiz before the unit starts, and the rotation question, missed by 49 of 84, opens the first lesson.

The 12-person fantasy football league at Lorimer Freight answers a 5-question quiz on the weekend's games every Monday, and the week 9 standings post to the league's Slack channel with Dana Whitlow in first on 38 points.

The Coalport Riverhawks put a QR code on the scoreboard after the fifth inning that opens a 3-question fan quiz, 1,120 fans answer on their phones on Friday night, and one seat is drawn from the 612 perfect scores.
